name: lchown
synopsis: int lchown(const char *pathname, uid_t owner, gid_t group);
description: The lchown() system call changes the owner and group of the file specified by the pathname, but does not dereference symbolic links. Only a privileged process can change the owner, and the owner can change the group to one they are a member of.

parameters.name: pathname
parameters.description: Path to the file whose ownership is to be changed

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: The new owner user ID, or -1 to leave unchanged

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: The new group ID, or -1 to leave unchanged

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: Search permission is denied on a component of the path prefix
pathname points outside the accessible address space
Too many symbolic links were encountered in resolving pathname
A component of the path prefix is not a directory
The calling process did not have the required permissions to change owner and/or group
The named file resides on a read-only filesystem

versions: 4.4BSD and later; Linux behavior as per kernel versions
